summary: Verified in the binary (8606fead), and against the parent of the pre-0.35 tree: in a repo whose scenario index was never written, subject show / subject move (no such subject, and a transition not allowed) / evidence add --all-scenarios with a report no case of which names a scenario / review scenario of a scenario no feature declares / divergence accept of one are refused with their own codes and leave the repository byte for byte as it was; the pre-change binary rewrites .canon/ledger/kind=scenario on every one of them. subject move without --to is USAGE --to and writes nothing (the brief's no --to form never existed: --to is required). subject show --json has empty stderr and a SCENARIO_INDEX_REFRESHED meta warning; its effectNote names the refresh and says a refused call writes nothing; dashboard is effect write with one report output and an effectNote 'serves until signalled', listed notRun by the fixture and by L0.page, L0.no-prompt and the L1 checks; report check and selftest leave no file in a private TMPDIR on success, refusal and failure. atip check L0 and L1 are met (L0.refusal-effects passes). Full nextest 3933 passed. Blast radius: the index is now computed in memory by the refusal path and written by the accepted path with the call's own record, so two computations of one index exist; no test compares the in-memory result with what the old refresh wrote, so a divergence between them would not be caught.
